map.印度 NEFT/RTGS 转账前核对支行代码: Verify the branch code before India NEFT/RTGS transfers

map.示例：IFSC 结构与第 5 位规则: Example: IFSC structure and the 5th-character rule
map.输入 HDFC0001234，前 4 位为银行码、第 5 位固定为 0、后 6: Enter HDFC0001234: first 4 are the bank code, the 5th is fixed as 0, the last 6 are the branch identifier; changing the 5th to 1 triggers a format error.
map.IFSC 格式规则是什么？: What are the IFSC format rules?
map.11 位：前 4 位为银行字母码，第 5 位固定为 0，后 6 位为支行标识（字: 11 characters: first 4 are the bank letter code, the 5th is fixed as 0, the last 6 are the branch identifier (alphanumeric).
map.IFSC 有校验位吗？: Does IFSC have a check digit?
map.IFSC 没有算术校验位，页面校验长度、字符集与第 5 位固定规则。: IFSC has no arithmetic check digit; the page checks length, character set and the fixed 5th-character rule.
map.校验通过就能转账吗？: Can you transfer after passing validation?
map.不能保证。页面只校验格式，支行是否存在、是否支持该业务须由银行确认。: Not guaranteed. The page only checks format; whether the branch exists or supports the service must be confirmed by the bank.
